QueryMetricMeta.summary: Queries the descriptions of time-series monitoring items that are open to cloud monitoring.

schema.description: The Project to which the metric belongs, matched by equality.

Filter by labels, format `[{"name":"label name","value":"label value"},{"name":"label name","value":"label value"}]`.
Existing label name explanations: 

- MetricCategory: Description of the metric category  
- alertEnable: Whether an alert is needed  
- alertUnit: Suggested alert unit 
- unitFactor: Unit conversion factor  
- minAlertPeriod: Minimum alert period  
- productCategory: Product type category
The metric name, matched by equality.
Maximum number of items per page, default is 30.

Success.description: Indicates whether this call was successful.

ErrorCode.description: Status code, 200 indicates success, non-200 indicates failure.

Labels.description:
Labels of the monitoring item, a JSON string `[{"name":"label name","value":"label value"}]`, can be multiple, names can repeat.
Existing label name explanations: 

- metricCategory: Metric category 
- alertEnable: Whether it can alert  
- alertUnit: Alert unit 
- unitFactor: Unit conversion factor 
- minAlertPeriod: Minimum alert period 
- productCategory: Product

Dimensions.description: Dimensions of the monitoring item, separated by commas for multiple levels, e.g., userId,instanceId

Project.description: Project name of the monitoring item, used for querying monitoring data.

Periods.description: All statistical periods of the monitoring item, separated by commas, e.g., 15,60,900

Statistics.description: Statistical methods, separated by commas, e.g., Maximum,Minimum,Average
